report: Address 0xEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE was examined against its sibling addresses. SAME_FUNDER: the address was funded by 0x3f5CE5FBFe3E9af3971dD833D26bA9b5C936f0bE, a hot wallet of a large centralised exchange, which also funded more than 12,000 addresses. IDENTICAL_TX_PATTERN: the address repeats the exact same sequence as its siblings — same amounts in the same order, interacting with the same three contracts, with no variation. BURST_ACTIVITY: the address executed 44 transactions in a single 80-minute window and then went silent. No human signal is present in this evidence: there is no long history, no diverse counterparties, no unique behaviour and the history is not fresh.
title: Behaviour evidence report — cluster candidate, exchange hot wallet at issue
